_notes: Ps 89 (Vulgate) = 思高 Ps 90: verse 5 (89:5 'Et custodia in nocte') is a continuation of 思高 v.4 ('好像夜里的一更时间') and has no exact equivalent in 思高 v.5; translated using the 思高 text for the remainder of v.4 and a paraphrase for 'quæ pro nihilo habentur, eorum anni erunt'. Ps 89:6 (Vulgate) = 思高 Ps 90:5/6 — the Vulgate's 'mane sicut herba transeat, mane floreat et transeat' conflates 思高 vv.5–6 differently; used 思高 v.6 for 89:6. Ps 89:9 appears twice in the Latin with different verse content (9a and 9b), split to render 思高 v.9 across both. Vulgate Ps 9:22–39 = 思高 Ps 10:1–18 (Vulgate Ps 9 combines the Hebrew Psalms 9 and 10). Vulgate 9:25 'Exacerbavit Dominum peccator' conflates 思高 Ps 10:3–4; used 思高 Ps 10:3–4 text split across 9:24 and 9:25. Vulgate 9:26a/b do not correspond exactly to 思高 Ps 10:5 — translated by sense from 思高. Ps 90 (Vulgate) = 思高 Ps 91: v.1 in 思高 is split across two lines (思高 prints 'tu zhege…' twice); the breviary combines this into one string with *, split after the first half.
